verdict.rationale: TruffleHog has dedicated first-party docs for pre-commit hooks, including exact commands (`trufflehog git file://. --since-commit HEAD --results=verified,unknown --fail`), guidance on scoping via core.hooksPath or Husky, bypass instructions, and even pre-receive hook alternatives for server-side blocking. This directly matches the story of preventing secrets from entering git history via pre-commit hooks. Missing for 10: independent/community hands-on confirmation that the pre-commit hook works reliably in practice (evidence is vendor-docs only).
